name: Organisation 36
definition: Organised structure that is set up for a particular purpose, for example, a business, government body, department, charity, or financial institution.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name by which the party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for the organisation.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Purpose of the organisation, for example, charity.

TaxationCountry.name: Taxation Country
TaxationCountry.definition: Country of taxation of the organisation.

RegistrationCountry.name: Registration Country
RegistrationCountry.definition: Country in which the organisation is registered.

RegistrationDate.name: Registration Date
RegistrationDate.definition: Date and time at which the organisation was officially registered.

TaxIdentificationNumber.name: Tax Identification Number
TaxIdentificationNumber.definition: Number assigned by a tax authority to the organisation.

NationalRegistrationNumber.name: National Registration Number
NationalRegistrationNumber.definition: Number assigned by a national registration authority to the organisation.
